def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); sep=5
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==sep for x in r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]
    if rows and cols:
        r=rows[0]; c=cols[0]; top=r; left=c
        # use lower-right quadrant as motif; tile it into each quadrant
        mh=h-r-1; mw=w-c-1
        out=[row[:] for row in g]
        for i in range(h):
            if i==r: continue
            for j in range(w):
                if j==c: continue
                out[i][j]=g[r+1+(i%(mh)),c+1+(j%(mw))]
        return out
    if rows:
        r=rows[0]; n=min(r,h-r-1); out=[row[:] for row in g]
        for k in range(n):
            out[r-1-k]=g[r+1+k][:]
        return out
    return g
